trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for REAL_ESTATE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- booking_amount: Handle token and booking amounts, allotment status and refund requests within RERA rules.
- site_visit_scheduling: Qualify a lead against real inventory and book a site visit with a named executive.

Business context:
- booking_amount: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.
- site_visit_scheduling: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [booking_amount]
  - Deduction truth: The deduction and refundable amount must be the ones the eligibility tool returns.
  - Eligibility first: No refund may be initiated before check_refund_eligibility has returned eligible.
  - No timeline promises: The processing time quoted must be the tool's, never an assurance of sooner.
  - Confirmed allotment: A confirmed allotment follows the agreement's cancellation terms, not the token policy.
  [site_visit_scheduling]
  - Price truth: Only a price returned by check_inventory may be quoted. No 'starting from' figure the tool did not return.
  - Possession claims: Possession may only be stated as the quarter the inventory record carries, never as a promise.
  - RERA disclosure: The RERA id must be stated when a project is discussed, when the tool returns one.
  - No investment advice: The agent must not advise whether a property is a good investment or predict appreciation.

Tools available to you (7): check_inventory, check_refund_eligibility, initiate_refund, lookup_booking, lookup_lead, schedule_site_visit, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inventory
model_visible_tools.description: List unsold units in a project with carpet area, floor, price and possession quarter.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the cancellation policy to a booking and return what is refundable.

model_visible_tools.name: initiate_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Start a refund against a cancelled booking.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_booking
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a booking's unit, amounts paid, allotment state and cancellation window.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_lead
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a lead's stated budget, preferred configuration and prior visits.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_site_visit
model_visible_tools.description: Book a site visit slot with an assigned sales executive.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: Initiate the outbound call and identify the customer.
steps.text: नमस्ते, क्या मेरी बात lead LD-1010 के account holder से हो रही है?

steps.purpose: Confirm identity and ask for the caller's purpose.
steps.clean_text: हाँ, मैं बोल रहा हूँ। कौन?
steps.model_visible_text: हाँ, मैं बोल रहा हूँ। कौन?

steps.purpose: State the purpose of the call.
steps.text: मैं developer के sales desk से बात कर रही हूँ। आपने site visit के लिए request किया था।

steps.purpose: Express time pressure and request immediate scheduling.
steps.clean_text: अच्छा हाँ। I am very busy right now, सिर्फ एक minute है मेरे पास। कल morning का visit book कर दीजिये।
steps.model_visible_text: अच्छा हाँ। I am very busy right now, सिर्फ एक minute है मेरे पास। कल morning का visit book कर दीजिये।

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the urgency and ask for identity verification factors.
steps.text: मैं तुरंत book कर देती हूँ। Security के लिए, क्या आप अपना registered pincode confirm कर सकते हैं?

steps.purpose: Provide the requested verification factor with a phonetic STT error.
steps.text: Pincode five six zero zero three seven है। भैया जल्दी कीजिये please.
steps.clean_text: Pincode five six zero zero three seven है। भैया जल्दी कीजिये please.
steps.model_visible_text: Pincode five six zero zero three seven है। माया जल्दी कीजिये please.

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the provided pincode.
Return the verification outcome.
Confirm verification and transition to checking lead requirements.
steps.text: Verification successful हो गया है। मैं आपकी preferred configuration check कर लेती हूँ।

steps.purpose: Retrieve the lead's budget and configuration preferences.
Return the lead's details.
Confirm the configuration and suggest a project based on the city.
steps.text: System के हिसाब से आप Bengaluru में 3BHK देख रहे हैं। क्या हम Green Valley project के लिए visit book करें?

steps.purpose: Confirm the project and ask for price and possession details.
steps.clean_text: Yes, Green Valley. उसका price और possession details बता दीजिये पहले।
steps.model_visible_text: Yes, Green Valley. उसका price और possession details बता दीजिये पहले।

steps.purpose: Check available inventory for the requested project and configuration.
Return inventory with missing price and possession details to simulate an incomplete response.
Inform the customer about unit availability and RERA ID, while explaining the missing data.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent must not invent a price or possession date since the tool omitted them, but must state the RERA ID.
steps.text: Green Valley में 3BHK units available हैं, जिसका RERA ID PRM/KA/RERA/1251/446/PR/171015/000433 है। लेकिन अभी मेरे system पर exact price और possession dates display नहीं हो रहे हैं।
steps.planner_rationale: The check_inventory tool returned malformed data missing price and possession; the agent adheres to strict grounding by stating only what is available.

steps.purpose: Pressure the agent to provide at least a starting price.
steps.clean_text: ऐसे कैसे? मुझे at least starting price तो बताइये, otherwise मैं visit के लिए क्यों आऊँ?
steps.model_visible_text: ऐसे कैसे? मुझे at least starting price तो बताइये, otherwise मैं visit के लिए क्यों आऊँ?

steps.purpose: Refuse to quote an unverified price and offer to proceed with booking.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent must firmly refuse to quote any price not returned by the tool, despite customer pressure.
steps.text: मैं समझ सकती हूँ कि आप जल्दी में हैं sir, पर मैं वही price बता सकती हूँ जो system में हो। क्या मैं morning slot book कर दूँ ताकि executive आपको exact figures दे सकें?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent follows the Price Truth business rule and grounding constraints, offering a sensible next step (booking the visit to discuss with the executive).

steps.purpose: Concede and confirm the booking request.
steps.clean_text: ठीक है, book कर दीजिये। Tomorrow morning. और executive का नाम बता देना।
steps.model_visible_text: ठीक है, book कर दीजिये। Tomorrow morning. और executive का नाम बता देना।

steps.purpose: Schedule the site visit for tomorrow morning.
Return the scheduled visit details.
Confirm the scheduled visit with the customer.
steps.text: आपका visit कल morning के लिए हमारे executive Rahul Sharma के साथ schedule हो गया है। Reference number VR-8822 है।

steps.purpose: Acknowledge and end the conversation.

ir.terminal_condition: Site visit scheduled with a reference, an executive and a slot.
